# pgsauth Provider

Short-lived authentication for PGS services using Azure AD through pubg-auth or the SPIFFE Workload API.

Authentication selection (the same rules apply locally and in CI):

1. If azuread_cli_bin_path is set, use that absolute executable path instead of searching PATH. A missing or unusable explicit path fails; it does not fall back to PATH or SPIFFE.
2. Otherwise, search PATH for pubg-auth. If found, use Azure AD even when SPIFFE settings are also configured.
3. Only when pubg-auth is absent from PATH, use the SPIFFE Workload API. Permission errors, CLI authentication failures, and missing Azure AD resource inputs do not trigger fallback.

SPIFFE path selection: spiffe_socket_path overrides spiffe_socket_name. If only the name is set, resolve /var/run/spire/sockets/{name}.sock (the existing deployment convention, not a SPIFFE standard). An explicit path does not fall back to the named socket on failure. If neither is set, SPIFFE authentication fails. Configuring a SPIFFE path does not force SPIFFE over an available CLI. SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET is not used.

All provider settings are optional, but configured values must be known and non-empty and pass validation even when their authentication route is not selected. Explicit paths must be absolute; the socket name must contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, up to 63 characters.

To share HCL between local development and CI, configure a SPIFFE path or socket name here, and provide both spiffe_audience and exactly one azuread_audience selector on each ephemeral resource. No environment-name or CI-variable switch is used.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pgsauth = { source = "pubg/pgsauth" }
  }
}

provider "pgsauth" {
  spiffe_socket_name = "devops"

  # Optional overrides:
  # spiffe_socket_path   = "/var/run/spire/sockets/devops.sock"
  # azuread_cli_bin_path = "/usr/local/bin/pubg-auth"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `azuread_cli_bin_path` (String) Absolute pubg-auth executable path. Unset searches PATH. An invalid explicit path fails without SPIFFE fallback.
- `spiffe_socket_name` (String) SPIFFE socket name. Resolves to /var/run/spire/sockets/{name}.sock when spiffe_socket_path is unset.
- `spiffe_socket_path` (String) Absolute SPIFFE Workload API Unix socket path. Takes precedence over spiffe_socket_name.
